# criv

criv is an open-source Rust command-line tool. It keeps repository documentation
connected to the code it describes. It runs locally and needs no server.

## Install

Add this to the target repository's `mise.toml`:

```toml
[tools."github:TudorAndrei/criv"]
version = "latest"
```

Then run:

```sh
mise install
criv init
criv watch --once
criv check
```

`criv init` does not create or update editor files. The optional local viewer
is in each release archive. Install it into one selected editor:

```sh
criv install-editor --editor code
criv install-editor --editor cursor
```

Use `--dry-run` to check the editor and bundled viewer without an editor change.

## Agent workflow

An agent must run `criv init` at the repository root. It must read the existing
documentation and ADRs. If past project conversations are available, it can
read them too. It must compare this evidence with the current code before it
creates ADRs. It must not invent a decision history.
